documents.text: Every Mother Counts (album) Every Mother Counts (sometimes subtitled "Songs Inspired by the Documentary 'No Woman, No Cry' Directed by Christy Turlington Burns") is a charity compilation album and soundtrack for Christy Turlington's 2010 documentary film "No Woman, No Cry" by various artists, released by Starbucks record label Hear Music on April 12, 2011.
